title: Handwritten TL Hex8 elastic reference kernel
objective: Implement full Total Lagrangian Hex8 elastic path with Newton-Raphson loop and imported linear solver as a trusted handwritten reference.

plan_assets.asset_description: Taichi tensor ops library used by reference kernel
Physical benchmark suite with acceptance tolerances

implementation_steps: Implement Hex8 shape functions and Gauss quadrature (2x2x2)
Implement deformation gradient computation F = I + du/dX
Implement patch test, rigid body motion, and cantilever checks
deliverables: Passing patch test, rigid body motion, and cantilever verification
acceptance_criteria: Patch test: constant strain reproduced to relative error < 1e-12
Rigid body motion: zero force to norm < 1e-12
Cantilever: tip displacement within 5% of EB beam theory (coarse mesh)

cases: Patch test with irregular Hex8 mesh
Rigid body translation produces zero internal force
Rigid body rotation produces zero internal force
Cantilever beam tip displacement vs analytical

risks: Numerical precision in large-deformation regime — use f64 throughout per 07-CONVENTIONS.md
Quadrature accuracy for irregular elements — verify with patch test
